typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		SUBSCRIBER_ID as string,
		STATE_ID as string,
		FULL_NAME as string,
		DOB as date,
		CASE_ID as string,
		MEMBER_PHONE as string,
		MEMBER_EMAIL as string,
		SERVICECODE as string,
		SERVICE_STARTDATE as timestamp,
		SERVICE_ENDDATE as timestamp,
		PROVIDERNAME as string,
		BARRIERS as string,
		QUANTITY as string,
		POCEFFDATE as timestamp,
		SCOPEOFSUPPORTSTOBEPROVIDED as string,
		CARECOORDINATOR_NAME as string,
		CARECOORDINATOR_PHONE as string,
		CARECOORDINATOR_EMAIL as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT [SUBSCRIBER_ID],[STATE_ID],[FULL_NAME],[DOB],[CASE_ID],[MEMBER_PHONE],[MEMBER_EMAIL],[SERVICECODE],[SERVICE_STARTDATE],[SERVICE_ENDDATE],[PROVIDERNAME],[BARRIERS],[QUANTITY],[POCEFFDATE],[SCOPEOFSUPPORTSTOBEPROVIDED],[CareCoordinator_Name],[CareCoordinator_Phone],[CareCoordinator_Email] FROM [EXTRACT].[ACCESS2CARE_STAGING]',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> NewMemberTab
NewMemberTab derive({Copy of CARECOORDINATOR_NAME} = toString(CARECOORDINATOR_NAME),
		{Copy of BARRIERS} = toString(BARRIERS),
		{Copy of SERVICECODE} = toString(SERVICECODE),
		{Copy of DOB} = toString(DOB),
		{Copy of CARECOORDINATOR_EMAIL} = toString(CARECOORDINATOR_EMAIL),
		{Copy of MEMBER_PHONE} = toString(MEMBER_PHONE),
		{Copy of SERVICE_ENDDATE} = toString(SERVICE_ENDDATE),
		{Copy of SERVICE_STARTDATE} = toString(SERVICE_STARTDATE),
		{Copy of SUBSCRIBER_ID} = toString(SUBSCRIBER_ID),
		{Copy of CASE_ID} = toString(CASE_ID),
		{Copy of STATE_ID} = toString(STATE_ID),
		{Copy of CARECOORDINATOR_PHONE} = toString(CARECOORDINATOR_PHONE),
		{Copy of FULL_NAME} = toString(FULL_NAME),
		{Copy of MEMBER_EMAIL} = toString(MEMBER_EMAIL),
		{Copy of POCEFFDATE} = toString(POCEFFDATE),
		{Copy of QUANTITY} = toString(QUANTITY),
		{Copy of PROVIDERNAME} = toString(PROVIDERNAME),
		{Copy of SCOPEOFSUPPORTSTOBEPROVIDED} = toString(SCOPEOFSUPPORTSTOBEPROVIDED)) ~> DataConversion
